1.consolidated_definition: Insecto himenóptero de hasta 3 cm de longitud, de color negro, con alas brillantes de matices verdosos, tórax liso, patas velludas, y aguijón largo y fino. Apidae, Antophoraspp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Hymenopteran insect of up to 3 cm in length, black in color, with shiny wings featuring greenish hues, smooth thorax, hairy legs, and a long and slender stinger. Apidae, Antophora spp.
